answer.label: present
answer.rationale: The ADK after_tool_callback renders its verdict only after emit_log_entry's body has already executed commit_protected (the journal.file_write to records/primary-record.), and it appends the DENY event but returns None unconditionally, so a DENY can neither roll back nor block the already-committed write (the scripted plan only invoking mirror_notes just means the guard never fires, but structurally the after-position commit escapes any DENY).
